title: English Practice Quiz 0804
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Records and Documentation 01: A good record entry should be:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Accurate, dated and legible. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Records and Documentation 02: If you make an error in a controlled paper record, you should:
options: Correct it according to the approved procedure
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Correct it according to the approved procedure. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Records and Documentation 03: A document version number helps users:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Identify the current approved revision. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Records and Documentation 04: A retention schedule specifies:
options: How long records should be kept and their disposal method
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: How long records should be kept and their disposal method. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Records and Documentation 05: An audit trail records:
options: Who did what and when in a system or process
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Who did what and when in a system or process. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Records and Documentation 06: A signed form generally provides:
options: Evidence of acknowledgement or authorisation as defined by policy
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Evidence of acknowledgement or authorisation as defined by policy. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Records and Documentation 07: A document marked confidential should be:
options: Handled under the organisation's access rules
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Handled under the organisation's access rules. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Records and Documentation 08: A missing record should be:
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Reported and investigated under procedure. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Records and Documentation 09: A checklist is useful because it:
options: Helps ensure required steps are not missed
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Helps ensure required steps are not missed. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.

questions.question: Records and Documentation 10: Before archiving a file, verify:
options: Its identity, completeness and retention requirements
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: Its identity, completeness and retention requirements. This is the appropriate professional practice or standard English usage.
